taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-01 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 332.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 601.3 | 6.89 | 7.41
3 | 359.9 | 16.01 | 23.42
4 | 286.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as K-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-01
Curve type: K-type
Aquifer depth: 23.42 m to depth (base of Layer 3, within the underlying lower-resistivity Layer 4)
Recommendation: Target drilling below 23.42 m, where resistivity drops to 286.0 ohm-m, as this is the probable water-bearing zone; since Layer 4 thickness is unconstrained by the VES data, plan for sufficient drilling depth and confirm the aquifer base with lithological logging during drilling.
